# Generated Files Guide

Use this file to avoid editing generated artifacts by hand.

## Do Not Edit Manually

- `src/jit_solver/components/port_registry.h`
  - Auto-generated (file header says DO NOT EDIT).
  - Source of truth is component library blueprints in `library/**/*.blueprint`.
  - Regenerated by tool target `update_port_registry`.

- `src/jit_solver/components/provider_components.h`
  - Treat as generated/templated artifact for provider-pattern compatibility.
  - Do not patch directly during migration work.
  - If behavior must change, update generator/source workflow, then regenerate.

- `generated/*.cpp`, `generated/*.h` (when present)
  - AOT output files.
  - Regenerate via codegen workflow instead of manual edits.

## Build Artifacts (Never Commit)

- `build*/` directories
- `Testing/Temporary/*`
- `.cache/clangd/*`

These files change frequently and are environment-specific.

## Regeneration Commands

```bash
# Regenerate port registry from library blueprints
cmake --build build --target update_port_registry
./build/tools/update_port_registry library
```

If a generated file appears stale, regenerate it first, then re-run build/tests.
